04/23.02.2021:

This interlocutory application has been filed praying therein to Para-1 and prayer portion of the main petition on the ground of subsequent development, which has taken place during the pendency of the main petition.

Counsel for the petitioner submits that during the pendency of the main petition, the court below has taken cognizance on 24.7.2019 under Sections 272, 273, 460, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Section 7 of the Essential Commodities Act and Section 16 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act against the petitioner.

He further submits that since cognizance has been taken during the pendency of the main petition, the petitioner may be permitted to challenge the order taking cognizance by making necessary amendment in the main petition.
Learned Spl.P.P submits that this is a fresh cause of action, for which, the petitioner should file a fresh petition.

After hearing the parties, I find that in the main petition, the petitioner has challenged the entire criminal proceeding in connection with Khunti P.S. Case No. 55/2018 (G.R.No.141/2018) and during the pendency of this petition, chargesheet has been submitted and cognizance has been taken.
Since, cognizance has already been taken during the pendency of the main petition, to avoid multiplicity of the proceeding, I am inclined to allow this interlocutory application.
The order taking cognizance will be treated to be the impugned order in this case.

The petitioner is directed to file an Sarita Devi vs The State Of Jharkhand on 23 February, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16570173/
1 amended memo of petition.
